title: Why Not Ads
body:
**I made this for fun, Do not expect this to get updated much!**

Have you ever wanted to know what Minecraft would look like with **Ads**? With this mod, Ads are now a thing in Minecraft with this mod!

## Features:
- Random pop up ads.
- Paintings has ads.


This mod was made using MCreator and like mentioned before, **I made this for fun, Do not expect this mod to get updated much! The ads are also fake, They are all Minecraft related!**
